query:
Use ultra effort for this specific joint temperature-learning limit. User approves sending these details. At one base point a four-cycle has x=(k,m,w) in R12, one SHARED translation per undirected edge, D_e=((k_next-k_i-w_e)^2+(m_next-m_i-w_e)^2)/2. Each of 16 assignments sigma chooses one neighbor per receiver. V_sigma=sum_i D_edge(i,sigma_i)=x'H_sigma x/2. Omega=I+2 D_ev'D_ev, D_ev x=k-m. Dynamics dX=-(H_sigma+T Omega)X dt+sqrt(2T)dW. One rate-one clock redraws the WHOLE assignment from conditional Gibbs product rows p_ij exp(-D_edge/T). Deterministic rows learn from actual q_t: p_i'=eps(q_t(sigma_i=+)-p_i), start 1/2. Initial q=N(m0,I12) times uniform labels.
Already proved: at each fixed sufficiently small T, for Lebesgue-a.e. fixed m0, sup_[tL,2tL] q_t(S!=M_T(m0))->0 as eps->0, tL=C eps^-1 log(1/eps). C=2 works for every fixed T since unstable eigenvalue alpha>=7/5. Frozen uniform rows converge symmetrically. Entropy identity holds for actual q. Seven-dimensional active frozen entropy rate >=c T^2.5/(1+log(1/T)+log(1/pmin)). Global fitness bound C/T gives tracking error O(eps T^-3.5 [1+log(1/T)+log(1/eps)]). eps=T^a with a>3.5 suffices for TRACKING but does not prove branch selection.
Initial imprint j_T(m)=v dot integral E_frozen[b(X_t)-1/2]dt, v=(1,-1,1,-1), is entire and nonzero in m at each fixed T, hence null zero set. Nonvanishing uses m=s u, u=(zero k,zero m,links(0,1,0,-1)), s->infinity: j_T(su)>=log(s)/(2T)-5loglog(s)/T-O_T(1). It is not uniform for fixed m asT->0. At t1=eps^-1/4 unstable amplitude=eps*j_T(m)/2+O_T,m(eps^1.25), transverse O_T,m(eps). Refined tracking local error<=O_T(eps)|p-1/2|+O_T,m(eps^1.75). Cone escape proves selection. Missing joint bounds include imprint floor and initial-layer remainders.
Resolve: (1) Can a computable fixed power eps=T^a give selection for a.e.fixed m? Prove needed lower/asymptotic bounds on j_T and remainders; generic averaging is insufficient. (2) If unavailable, prove strongest universal diagonal or stepwise schedule T_n->0 and eps thresholds independent of m giving a.e.fixedmean selection, via summable exceptional sets. Distinguish a matching allowed to vary with n from a fixed limiting matching, and nonconstructive thresholds from an explicit power law. (3) A logical counterexample to deriving a power law solely from fixed-T results is useful but is not a model counterexample. Do not change model or initial preparation. No base transport or Lean. Give derivations or exact unresolved obligations, not a reading list. Use only necessary primary sources with exact theorem locator; each source used must be downloaded/ingested. Prior run agent_run_597d9ae8f5af40b2aaa536fa273ea6b6 is context only; its stronger claims were not adopted without proof.
